values.note: Pay at the self-serve fee station.

values.note: 'Campsites cannot be reserved by simply paying for the site; camper must be present.'

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/thain-creek-campground ('All campgrounds on the Helena-Lewis and Clark National Forest are first-come, first-served. Reservations are not available. Camping is limited to 16 consecutive days in one location.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Only one of the 19 sites is stated to take a 40-ft trailer; the others' lengths are not published.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/thain-creek-campground ('One of the 19 campsites can accommodate a maximum trailer length of 40 feet.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: Seasons of Use 'May - November'; 'usually open from May through the middle of fall'; dates vary with snowfall.

Drinking water: Current Conditions (May 2026) says 'no water.'; the amenity list says potable water is available, and the forest's standard text says 'during the warmer months'. Horses not allowed; OHVs must stay on the campground road.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/thain-creek-campground (Restrooms 'Vault toilet(s)'; Current Conditions 'no water.'; Water 'Potable water is available at this site.'), read 2026-10-22

note: The only campground in the Highwood Mountains, Helena-Lewis & Clark NF, east of Great Falls: US-89 6 mi, MT-228 13 mi, County Road 121 16 mi, then FR 8840 2 mi, the last on dirt and gravel. Windy Mountain 6-mi loop trail nearby; Highwoods trails close Sept 1 or Oct 15. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated May 22, 2026): confirmed $10, 19 sites, one taking a 40-ft trailer, first-come, vault toilets; added 16-day stay limit and May-November season. Drinking water left as is (Current Conditions 'no water' vs amenity list 'available'). Not stated: hookups (derived none left). Note trimmed of restated values; dropped the unsourced 'rocky, bumpy... not 4WD-only' road description in favour of FS directions.
